architecture_override.critical_guard: single-flow is PER TRANSPORT LANE. One Logical Tunnel owns stable TunnelID/lease and one SessionID/PacketID race domain with 1..4 logical lanes. Normal desired=1; Game/weak desired=2..4. Game is first-arrival + dedup with no cross-lane HOL; FEC never crosses lanes.
architecture_override.replacement: Healthy replacement is A -> A+B -> B; candidate failure preserves A. At most 4 logical lanes exist. A fifth physical slot is replacement overlap only, never as a fifth logical lane.
architecture_override.windows_outer_path: Sustained Windows outer path is Npcap/raw FakeTCP; there is no ordinary kernel-TCP Reality preconnection.
architecture_override.server_path: Linux final path is one shared WBD TUN + root routing + one WBD-owned host NAT.
architecture_override.lease_source_boundary: Raw IPv4 ingress requires source == server-issued Logical Tunnel lease. Wintun must not leak APIPA/arbitrary IPv4 or non-IPv4 into the IPv4 Game/raw-IP backend.
architecture_override.ipv6: Windows product IPv6 remains fail-closed until qualified.
